title: Headless Back in Your Own Backyard (VNelson), the fail: Ranger Milo's request (stage 10), the hostages killed (15), Milo killed (20)

actions.text: Path, the fail: Ranger Milo's request as in back-in-your-own-backyard (stage 10); the three hostages killed instead of freed (kill stands in for the player's shots; their death script counts HostagesKilled and sets 15 at three while Milo lives); then Milo killed (MiloScript's OnDeath sets 20 at stage 15). Travel is move_player.
Stand-in for the trip to the ranger checkpoint.

Near Nelson the Legion explorers each stop the player once (two here) when his script first runs (nvNelsonExplorerBarkSCRIPT: StartConversation while We Are Legion has not started); the player walks off from each.

actions.label: no friend of the legion (Speech 25; follow-up: his Topic006 line)
